synths.notes: Loop and sample instrument, Arcade 2.x (2.16.1 in August 2026). sources.says: Review: all 15 loops of a kit play from the white keys C2 to C4; the black keys trigger editable performance effects.

Output: in Instruments the black keys are chromatic notes, so there are no modifiers (seen in search excerpts).

synths.instead: Surge XT, from the same team, has MPE.

sources.says: MIDI handler treats pitch wheel and pressure as plain MIDI; 'MPE' does not appear in the source.
Formats: CLAP, VST3, Standalone (VST2 only when the SDK is supplied).

synths.name: OB-Xf
synths.enable: Global section > MPE button (lit); the cogwheel beside it opens the MPE page. MPE Roll's MCM (RPN 6) also turns it on.
synths.bendRange: MPE page (cogwheel) > MPE Glide Range, 0-96 (default 48)
synths.notes: Free, open-source continuation of OB-Xd by the Surge Synth Team. Version 1.1 is in beta, with nightly Windows x64/ARM installers. Pitch bend, pressure and CC74 are handled per voice.
synths.advice: OB-Xf turns MPE on from MPE Roll's MPE setup message; if it doesn't, click MPE in its global section. Keep MPE Glide Range (cogwheel > MPE page) at 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: mpeButton toggles MPE, mpeSettingsButton shows the MPE panel, mpeGlideRangeMenu sets the MPE bend range.
MPE mode: pitch bend, pressure and CC74 per voice; RPN 0 on member channels sets the MPE range; RPN 6 (lower zone) toggles MPE.
Default mpePitchBendRange 48; maximum 96.

synths.name: Shortcircuit XT
synths.enable: Header channel-usage button (shows Omni) > MPE
synths.bendRange: Header channel-usage menu > MPE Settings: 12, 24, 48 or 96 (default 24)
synths.noteExpressions: CLAP: Volume, Pan, Tuning, Vibrato, Expression, Brightness and Pressure arrive as Note Expressions modulation sources.
synths.notes: Free, open-source sampler, still in beta (nightly builds). MPE pitch bend, timbre and pressure are voice modulation sources. The same menu can make MPE the default for new instances.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Shortcircuit XT: click the channel-usage button in its header (shows Omni) > MPE, then in the same menu set MPE Settings to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range (default 24).

sources.says: 'MIDI Channel usage' menu: Omni / MPE / Channel-Octave, plus an MPE Settings submenu with 12/24/48/96 semitone bend range.
Default mpePitchBendRange 24.
MPE mod sources and CLAP note-expression sources (Volume, Pan, Tuning, Vibrato, Expression, Brightness, Pressure).

synths.name: Six Sines
synths.enable: Main panel play-mode area (or Settings gear) > Play / Settings > MPE + Smoothing > MPE Active: On
synths.bendRange: Play / Settings > MPE + Smoothing > MPE Bend Range (default 24)
synths.noteExpressions: CLAP: Tuning and Pan note expressions only. The VST3 (clap-wrapper) also offers Tuning and Pan note expressions.
synths.notes: Free, open-source 6-operator FM synth (1.2.1). Since 1.2 the MPE settings are saved with the DAW session, not the patch. MPE pressure and timbre are modulation sources.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Six Sines: click the play-mode area of the Main panel > MPE + Smoothing > MPE Active, and set MPE Bend Range to 48 (default 24), MPE Roll's per-note bend range.
synths.clapAdvice: Its CLAP version needs nothing set up when Note expressions are on in MPE settings.

sources.says: Click the play-mode area of the Main panel to open Play / Settings; since 1.2 MPE enable and bend range live on the engine, not the patch.
Section 'MPE + Smoothing' with 'MPE Active' toggle, 'MPE Bend Range' and 'Save as MPE/Smoothing Defaults'.
Handles CLAP note expressions; MIDI, MIDI_MPE and CLAP note dialects; VST3 note expressions Tuning and Pan.

synths.name: Surge XT
synths.enable: Header status area > MPE button (lit), or Menu > MPE Settings > Enable MPE. MPE Roll's MCM (RPN 6) also turns it on.
synths.bendRange: Right-click MPE > Set MPE Pitch Bend Range (default 48); RPN 0 on channel 2 also sets it
synths.noteExpressions: CLAP: Tuning, Volume, Pan, Pressure and Brightness (as timbre) per note; Vibrato and Expression are ignored. The VST3 has no note expressions.
synths.notes: MPE since Surge 1.6.0 (2019). The MPE state is saved with the DAW project, not the patch. RPN 0 sets the per-note range only on MIDI channel 2. VST2 only if self-built.
synths.advice: Surge XT turns MPE on from MPE Roll's MPE setup message; if it doesn't, click MPE in its header. Keep its MPE Pitch Bend Range (right-click MPE) at 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.
synths.clapAdvice: Its CLAP version needs nothing set up when Note expressions are on in MPE settings.

sources.says: Manual: select MPE in the status area to toggle MPE mode; right-click it for MPE settings, which are also in the main menu.
MPE menu: Enable/Disable MPE, Set MPE Pitch Bend Range, Set Default MPE Pitch Bend Range (default 48), Pitch Bend Smoothing, Timbre Range.
CLAP note expressions Volume, Pan, Tuning, Brightness (timbre) and Pressure go to each voice; Vibrato and Expression are unused.

synths.name: SwarPlug
synths.enable: PITCH/MPE pane > Pitch Channel: ALL (accepts bends on every member channel)
synths.bendRange: PITCH/MPE pane > PBR, plus a downward PBR field since 4.3.0; default not found
synths.notes: Indian instruments ROMpler. MPE came with SwarPlug 4 (Aug 2018). The Pitch Channel detail comes only from a user-uploaded copy of the version notes. Windows formats not confirmed.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in SwarPlug: PITCH/MPE pane > Pitch Channel: ALL, with PBR (and the downward PBR, if shown) at 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: Changelog mirror: 4.0.0 (Aug 2018) adds MPE; 4.0.1 fixes a PBR prompt; 4.0.3 fixes pitch selection in the MPE/Pitch panel.
SwarPlug 4 adds buses, effects, MPE support, key mapping, portamento and legato.
User-uploaded version notes: 4.3.0 adds a downward PBR in the PITCH/MPE pane; Pitch Channel ALL accepts bends on all channels.

synths.name: Antidote
synths.notes: Synapse's MPE updates cover Dune 3 and The Legend, and Antidote's own updates never mention MPE. Also a Reason Rack Extension. Windows formats not checked. Use Plain MIDI.
synths.instead: Dune 3, from the same maker, has MPE.

sources.says: Synapse's MPE work covers Dune 3 (3.64 expands MPE); Antidote is not mentioned.
Synapse updates The Legend with MPE (v1.2); Antidote is not mentioned.
Lists Antidote as a software synth; MPE coverage is for other Synapse products.

synths.name: Dune 3
synths.enable: Settings tab > MPE Controller: On (lock it so preset changes don't reset it, v3.65+)
synths.bendRange: Fixed at 48 when MPE Controller is on
synths.notes: Full MPE since v3.6 (Nov 2023); v3.64 extended it. Before the v3.65 lock, preset changes could reset it. A forum user says MPE does not work in Mono Legato mode.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Dune 3: Settings tab > MPE Controller (lock it so presets don't reset it); its bend range is then fixed at 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range. Avoid Mono Legato mode.

sources.says: Quoting Synapse: Settings tab 'MPE Controller' switch turns MPE on, fixes the pitch bend range to +/-48 and adds Rise/Fall times.
Dune 3.6 free update brings full MPE support.
Forum: MPE works in Mono Legato in The Legend HZ but not in Obsession or Dune.

synths.name: Obsession
synths.enable: Not documented (Synapse only says it supports MPE)
synths.notes: OB-Xa-inspired two-part synth (2020). Synapse's manual says it supports MPE, but no MPE control is documented. A forum user says MPE fails in Mono Legato mode. VST3 not confirmed.
synths.advice: Obsession supports MPE but its MPE switch is not documented (Dune 3 has Settings tab > MPE Controller). Set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range, and use a poly mode, not Mono Legato.

sources.says: Manual: supports Multidimensional Polyphonic Expression (MPE) and NKS.
Retailer: MPE and NKS support; VST, AU, AAX, Rack Extension.
Forum: MPE works in Mono Legato in The Legend HZ but not in Obsession or Dune.

synths.name: Proxima
synths.enable: Not documented (Synapse only says it supports MPE)
synths.notes: Sequential Prophet-600 emulation with 12 voices, released Oct 2025. Synapse lists MPE support, but no manual section or switch name was found.
synths.advice: Proxima supports MPE but where to turn it on is not documented; look in its settings for an MPE switch and set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: Maker's page: supports MPE and NKS; VST, AAX and Audio Unit.
Launch: Windows and Mac in VST3, AU and AAX; MPE, MTS and NKS support.
Feature list includes MPE (MIDI Polyphonic Expression).

synths.name: The Legend
synths.enable: Voice mode: one of the Polyphony modes (MPE works only in Poly mode)
synths.notes: MPE added in free update v1.2 (Jan 2018) and works only in the polyphonic voice modes, not Mono or Unison. AAX came in v1.3. VST3 not verified. Succeeded by The Legend HZ.
synths.advice: The Legend has MPE only in its Polyphony voice modes (4 or 8 voices), not Mono or Unison: pick one, and set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: v1.2 (9 Jan 2018) adds NKS, MPE when in Poly mode, and a Performance matrix on the back panel.
Product page: Unison, Mono, 4- and 8-voice Polyphony modes.
Version 1.3 adds AAX support and increased polyphony.

synths.name: The Legend HZ
synths.enable: Not confirmed; the back panel has an MPE Advanced mode (v2.01) for Rise/Fall times
synths.bendRange: Probably fixed at 48 in MPE mode, as in Dune 3 whose MPE came from it (not confirmed)
synths.notes: Made with Hans Zimmer (May 2024), successor to The Legend. v2.01 added an MPE Advanced mode on the back panel. MPE reportedly works in Mono Legato mode too.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in The Legend HZ: look for an MPE Controller switch in its settings (as in Dune 3, whose MPE came from it); the back panel's MPE Advanced mode only sets Rise/Fall times. Its bend range is then probably fixed at 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: Product page: supports MIDI Polyphonic Expression (MPE) and NKS.
v2.01: an MPE Advanced mode was added on the back panel, allowing Rise/Fall times to be set.
Quoting Synapse: Dune 3's MPE features (MPE Controller, +/-48 bend, Rise/Fall) came from The Legend HZ.

synths.name: Magnus Choir
synths.notes: Choir and vocal textures for 64-bit Windows. The Windows v2.5 notes list pitch bend for the 32-bit version only. Use Plain MIDI.

sources.says: Maker's page: VST and VST3 for Windows 64-bit; no MPE.
Windows v2.5 adds VST3 and MIDI CC parameters; pitch bend for the 32-bit version only; no MPE.

synths.name: Ivory 3 American Concert D
synths.notes: A 1951 Steinway D on the Ivory 3 engine (Oct 2024), with 4 stereo mic positions. Same Windows formats as German D. No MPE documentation. Use Plain MIDI.

sources.says: 1951 Steinway D, 4 stereo mic positions. No MPE mention.
Ivory 3 engine on Windows: VST3, AAX, or the included Ivory 3 Cantabile application.

synths.name: Ivory 3 German D
synths.notes: Ivory 3 engine, on Windows since Oct 2023. Continuous Velocity and 'MIDI 2.0 ready' high-resolution velocity are not MPE. The Windows standalone is the bundled Ivory 3 Cantabile host. Use Plain MIDI.

sources.says: Windows: any VST3 host, Pro Tools 11+ (AAX), or the included Ivory 3 Cantabile application. No MPE.
Ivory 3 released for Windows in Oct 2023. No MPE.
Review: VST3, AU, AAX plus standalone; Continuous Velocity. No MPE.

synths.name: Ivory 3 LE Uprights
synths.notes: Yamaha U5 (Modern) and 1914 A.M. Hume (Vintage) rebuilt for Ivory 3 (Oct 2025). A user reports the first Windows build 3.0.8 broke loading; 3.0.8.1 reportedly fixed it. Use Plain MIDI.

sources.says: Yamaha U5 and 1914 A.M. Hume rebuilt for Ivory 3. No MPE mention.
Retailer lists LE Uprights as Standalone, AAX, AU, VST (conflicts with Synthogy's page); no MPE.

synths.name: TAL-BassLine-101
synths.enable: Its MPE settings (exact label not documented)
synths.notes: SH-101 emulation (mono, with poly/unison modes). MPE since V3 (Dec 2019). TAL documents MPE for cutoff and volume only; per-note pitch is not stated. Formats not checked.
synths.advice: TAL-BassLine-101's MPE drives only cutoff and volume per note (per TAL), so per-note bends may do nothing; turn on MPE in its settings if it is off.

sources.says: Features: MIDI control and automation, 'including MPE support for cutoff and volume'.
BassLine-101 V3 (Dec 2019) added MPE support.
Roger Linn Design added TAL-BassLine-101 to the LinnStrument Recommended Sounds page.

synths.name: TAL-DAC
synths.notes: Latest listed version 2.0.3. No MPE entries in TAL's changelog. Formats not re-checked. Use Plain MIDI.

sources.says: No MPE changelog entries for TAL-DAC.
TAL's MPE arrived in BassLine-101 V3 and U-NO-LX V4 (Dec 2019), not DAC.

synths.name: TAL-Drum
synths.notes: Drum sampler. Its manual does not mention MPE, and TAL's MPE news does not include it. Formats assumed from TAL's usual lineup. Use Plain MIDI.

sources.says: User manual; TAL-Drum is not named in TAL's MPE news.
TAL's MPE arrived in BassLine-101 V3 and U-NO-LX V4 (Dec 2019), not Drum.

synths.name: TAL-J-8
synths.enable: Its MPE settings (exact label not documented)
synths.notes: Jupiter-8 emulation with MPE since launch (Dec 2020). 2.0.1 (Sep 2025) added more MPE options for MPE hardware such as the Osmose. Formats not checked.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in TAL-J-8's settings if it is off (more MPE options since 2.0.1), and set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: Product page lists MPE support; changelog 2.0.1 (17.09.2025) adds more MPE options for various MPE hardware.
Launch coverage: Jupiter-8 emulation with MPE support.

synths.name: TAL-Mod
synths.enable: MPE button on the plugin interface (per a KVR user; position not confirmed)
synths.notes: MPE added in 1.5.0; 1.5.4 fixed MPE pressure and made timbre/slide non-bipolar. Only the changelog documents MPE, not the manual or product page. Formats not checked.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in TAL-Mod with the MPE button on its interface, and set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: Changelog: 1.5.0 added MPE support; 1.5.4 fixed MPE pressure and made MPE Timbre/Slide non-bipolar.
Forum: MPE is not in the manual or product page, but changelog 1.5 adds it and there is a big MPE button on the GUI.
Solidtrax bank with MPE-optimised presets for the MPE added in TAL-Mod 1.5.0.

synths.name: TAL-NoiseMaker
synths.notes: Free. Its changelog up to 5.0.6 (Aug 2023) has no MPE entry, and the feature list has none. Formats not verified. Use Plain MIDI.
synths.instead: TAL-U-NO-LX and TAL-J-8 from TAL have MPE.

sources.says: Product page and changelog to 5.0.6 (16 Aug 2023): velocity, pitch wheel, MIDI learn; no MPE.
TAL added MPE to BassLine-101 V3 and U-NO-LX V4 (Dec 2019); NoiseMaker not included.

synths.name: TAL-Pha
synths.enable: Its MPE settings (exact label not documented)
synths.notes: Alpha Juno II / MKS-50 emulation. TAL's feature list says 'Aftertouch and MPE support'. The manual excerpt found does not mention MPE. Formats not checked.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in TAL-Pha's settings if it is off, and set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: Features: 'Aftertouch and MPE support.'
Release news: VST, AU, AAX and CLAP.

synths.name: TAL-Sampler
synths.enable: Its MPE settings (exact label not documented)
synths.notes: TAL's Sep 2025 news names it among plugins with improved MPE settings, and Roger Linn Design lists it for LinnStrument. The version that added MPE was not found. Formats not checked.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in TAL-Sampler's settings if it is off, and set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: News 24.09.2025: TAL-U-NO-LX, TAL-Pha, TAL-J-8 and TAL-Sampler get improved MPE settings.
Roger Linn Design added TAL-Sampler to LinnStrument Recommended Sounds, which needs the maker to mention MPE compatibility.
Community MPE/poly aftertouch list includes TAL-Sampler.

synths.name: TAL-U-NO-LX
synths.enable: Its MPE settings (exact label not documented)
synths.bendRange: 48 per note, channel 1 as master (retailer copy of TAL's feature list)
synths.noteExpressions: CLAP: changelog 4.6.6 says 'CLAP MPE now works in Bitwig'; note-expression support is not stated.
synths.notes: Juno-60 emulation. MPE since V4 (Dec 2019). 5.1.1 (Sep 2025) added more MPE options for hardware such as the Osmose; 5.1.2/5.1.3 fixed MPE pitch during release. Formats not checked.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in TAL-U-NO-LX's settings if it is off; TAL lists a 48 per-note bend range with channel 1 as master, matching MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: Changelog: 4.2.2 MPE fixes; 4.6.6 'CLAP MPE now works in bitwig'; 4.8.4 MPE keyboard view; 5.1.1 more MPE options (Osmose).
TAL released BassLine-101 V3 and U-NO-LX V4 with new UIs and MPE support (Dec 2019).
Retailer feature list: MPE with +-48 semitones, MIDI channel 1 as master.

synths.name: Odin 2
synths.notes: Version 2.4.1. Pitch wheel and channel pressure are global and the MIDI channel is ignored, so per-note bends would bend every voice. It reads polyphonic aftertouch per note. No Windows standalone.

sources.says: Pitch wheel and channel pressure set one global value; poly aftertouch goes per voice; the MIDI channel is never read.
Changelog up to 2.4.1 (CLAP added in 2.3.3). No MPE entry.
Windows installer components: VST3 Plugin and CLAP Plugin only.

synths.name: Heavier7Strings
synths.notes: Sampled 7-string metal guitar (v1.7.0) with 16 amps, 19 effect modules and 300 MIDI patterns. No MPE mentioned. Use Plain MIDI.

sources.says: v1.7.0; VST, AU, VST3, AAX and Standalone; no MPE mentioned.
Review: sample-based virtual 7-string guitar; no MPE mentioned.

synths.name: RipplerX
synths.bendRange: PitchBend Range parameter, 1-24 (default 2), one global bend for all voices
synths.noteExpressions: None; no CLAP build (planned).
synths.notes: Free, open-source modal/waveguide model. It ignores the MIDI channel, channel pressure and CC74. Standalone only if self-built. Audio-in does not work in FL Studio. Use Plain MIDI.

sources.says: MIDI loop handles note on/off, sustain, all-notes-off and a channel-less pitch wheel; PitchBend Range 1-24, default 2.
README: VST3 and LV2 for Windows, plus AU; CLAP planned; audio-in not supported in FL Studio; no MPE.
Formats VST3, LV2, AU (+ Standalone if BUILD_STANDALONE); COMPANY_NAME Tilr.

synths.name: Electra 3
synths.notes: Covers Electra 3 and the older Electra 2 and ElectraX. Tone2's comparison lists MPE only for Icarus 3, and users say no Electra version has MPE. Use Plain MIDI.
synths.instead: Icarus 3, from Tone2, has MPE.

sources.says: Tone2 comparison: MPE support 'no' for Electra 3 (yes only for Icarus 3), as read by the earlier researcher.
Forum: an Electra 2 buyer lists 'no MPE support (Icarus has MPE)' as a downside.
KVR listing: Windows formats VSTi (32/64-bit), VST3 and Standalone. No AAX.

synths.advice: Electra 3, Electra 2 and ElectraX have no MPE.

synths.notes: Successor to Gladiator 3 (3.1 added VST3 and a Windows standalone). Tone2's comparison lists MPE only for Icarus 3. Use Plain MIDI.
synths.instead: Icarus 3, from Tone2, has MPE.

sources.says: Tone2 comparison: MPE support 'no' for Gladiator 4, as read by the earlier researcher.
Forum: a long-time user says Tone2 ignores MPE apart from Icarus.
Gladiator 4: Stand-Alone, AU, VST2 32/64-bit, VST3 64-bit. No AAX.

synths.name: Icarus 3
synths.enable: SETUP page > force MPE: On (Icarus 2.5: Enable MPE support)
synths.notes: Tone2's only synth with MPE; MPE since 2.5, extended to Legato and Mono modes in 3.1. Some hosts don't pass all 16 channels to the VST3; use the VST2 (Icarus.dll) then. Bend range setting not found.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Icarus: SETUP > force MPE, and set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range. If the VST3 ignores member channels, load the VST2 (Icarus.dll) instead.

sources.says: Tone2 comparison table: 'MPE support' yes only for Icarus 3.
Tone2 reply: go to SETUP and enable 'force MPE'. The DAW must send all 16 channels; not all do with VST3, so use Standalone, AU or VST2.
Icarus 3.1 update: MPE support for Legato and Mono modes.

synths.notes: neoFM synth; Nemesis 3 replaced Nemesis 2, with update 3.1 in 2026. Tone2's comparison lists MPE only for Icarus 3. Windows standalone not confirmed. Use Plain MIDI.
synths.instead: Icarus 3, from Tone2, has MPE.

sources.says: Tone2 comparison: MPE support 'no' for Nemesis 3, as read by the earlier researcher.
Forum: a long-time user says Tone2 ignores MPE apart from Icarus.

synths.name: RayBlaster 3
synths.notes: RayBlaster 3.0 came out in Nov 2023. Tone2's comparison lists MPE only for Icarus 3. Windows standalone not confirmed. Use Plain MIDI.
synths.instead: Icarus 3, from Tone2, has MPE.

sources.says: Tone2 comparison: MPE support 'no' for RayBlaster 3, as read by the earlier researcher.
RayBlaster 3 update news. No MPE mentioned.

synths.notes: Analog-modelling synth, successor to Saurus 3. Tone2's comparison lists MPE only for Icarus 3. Windows standalone not confirmed. Use Plain MIDI.
synths.instead: Icarus 3, from Tone2, has MPE.

sources.says: Tone2 comparison: MPE support 'no' for Saurus 4, as read by the earlier researcher.
Forum: a long-time user says Tone2 ignores MPE apart from Icarus.

synths.name: Warlock
synths.notes: Successor (2021) to the free FireBird synth. Tone2's comparison lists MPE only for Icarus 3. Windows standalone not confirmed. Use Plain MIDI.
synths.instead: Icarus 3, from Tone2, has MPE.

sources.says: Tone2 comparison: MPE support 'no' for Warlock, as read by the earlier researcher.

synths.name: EZbass
synths.notes: Sampled bass. Toontrack documents no MPE. A forum user found slides from an MPE guitar sounded fretted on the Fretless EBX. Toontrack's requirements name VST3, AU or AAX hosts.

sources.says: EZbass release notes; no MPE mentioned.
Toontrack forum post (weak): EZbass Fretless EBX sounded fretted when sliding with an MPE guitar.

synths.name: EZdrummer 3
synths.notes: Drum sampler. Toontrack documents no MPE. Toontrack's requirements name VST3, AU or AAX hosts plus standalone; no VST2.

sources.says: Toontrack compatibility: host must support VST 3 (VST 2 only for EZmix 2), AU or AAX; standalone included.
Sound On Sound review; no MPE mentioned.

synths.name: EZkeys 2
synths.notes: Piano and keys with a songwriting engine. Toontrack documents no MPE. Toontrack and Sound On Sound give VST3, AU and AAX plus standalone; no VST2.

sources.says: Toontrack: host with VST 3 (VST 2 only for EZmix 2), AU or AAX; standalone included.
Sound On Sound: EZkeys 2 comes as VST3, AU and AAX.

synths.name: Superior Drummer 3
synths.notes: Drum production suite with e-kit MIDI mapping. Toontrack documents no MPE. Toontrack's requirements name VST3, AU or AAX hosts (VST2 only for EZmix 2), so current versions may lack VST2.

sources.says: Toontrack SD3 FAQ: 64-bit host with VST, AU or AAX; standalone included.
Toontrack compatibility: host must support VST 3 (VST 2 only for EZmix 2), AU or AAX; standalone included.
Retailer: AAX native, AU, VST3.

synths.name: Abyss II
synths.notes: Released August 2026 as a major upgrade to Abyss (2021). Synth Anatomy says it fully supports MPE with mappings to any target; all Dawesome synths support MPE. AAX not confirmed.
synths.advice: Abyss II responds to MPE with no switch documented and maps it to any target; set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: Abyss II 'supports fully MPE with all possible mappings to your controllers' and also works with non-MPE keyboards.
KVR forum (weaker): a post says all Dawesome instruments support MPE.

synths.name: BioTek 2
synths.enable: Global Menu > Activate MPE, then Instrument Edit page > Activate MPE On All Layers
synths.notes: MPE added in v2.1.5. The Global Menu switch is saved in preferences; each loaded instrument's layers also need MPE on. Replaced by BioTek 3. VST2 not verified.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in BioTek 2 (v2.1.5 or later): Global Menu > Activate MPE, then Instrument Edit page > Activate MPE On All Layers; set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: KVR post quoting v2.1.5 notes: 'Added MPE Support'; Activate MPE in the Global Menu; 'Activate MPE On All Layers' on the Instrument Edit page.

synths.name: BioTek 3
synths.notes: Current BioTek version. No maker statement on MPE. Users report per-note bend and glide working unreliably and differing by DAW (Bitwig, Reaper). No MPE switch or bend range setting found.
synths.advice: BioTek 3's MPE is reported unreliable: per-note bends and glide may fail. Set its bend range to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range, if it has one, and switch to Plain MIDI if bends do nothing.

sources.says: KVR forum (Dec 2024): MPE pitch bend/glide reported not working; works in Bitwig without glide; Reaper inconsistent.
Same KVR thread: MPE glide reported better in Reaper than Bitwig but unreliable.

synths.notes: Sample-based synth; Collective 2 adds VA oscillators, 4-op FM and more presets. No source mentions MPE.

sources.says: Collective 2 announcement: new sounds, VA oscillators, 4-op FM and FX; no MPE.

synths.name: Serum
synths.enable: MENU (top bar) > MPE Enabled
synths.bendRange: MENU > MPE Bend Range (48 ST, apparently the default)
synths.plainBendRange: Serum's own range is the two small boxes at the bottom left, by the pitch wheel: up and down in semitones (2 and -2 to start with; the down box takes a negative number), up to 24 and -24. It changes with the preset, so check it after loading one.
synths.notes: MPE arrived in 1.23 (March 2019) and is off by default; use 1.26b8 or later, since earlier builds ignored channel 16, cut a note played on two channels at once, and could crash on MPE bend-range messages. The newest 1.x in a copy of Xfer's update log (May 2026) is 1.36b8 (October 2023). Older versions such as 1.1.5 have no MPE Enabled item. VST3 on Windows since 1.35b7 (2022). Since 1.36b8 per-note bend also feeds MPE X.
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Serum 1.26b8 or later: MENU (top bar) > MPE Enabled, with MPE Bend Range 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range. An older Serum has no MPE (1.1.5, say) or MPE bugs MPE Roll runs into (1.23 to 1.26b7): update it from your Xfer account, or set Synth expects to One copy per note. Turn MPE off again for Plain MIDI.

sources.says: A copy of Xfer's own update log: 1.23b2 (6 March 2019) 'Preliminary MPE support'; 1.24b1 MPE off by default; 1.25b1 fixes MPE note-offs per channel and channel 16; 1.26b8 fixes a GUI crash on MPE bend-range messages; 1.36b8 (11 October 2023) the newest 1.x listed.
Jamstik guide: turn on MPE inside Serum from the Menu dropdown; MPE Bend Range shown at 48 ST. Turn MPE off when not using it.
Synthtopia, April 2019: Serum is now MPE-compatible.
Serum v1.35b7 adds VST3 support on macOS and Windows.
